types.label: ntfy
types.description: Push notifications to your phone or desktop via an ntfy topic (ntfy.sh or self-hosted).

fields.label: Server URL
fields.help: Leave blank for ntfy.sh. A self-hosted server must be reachable over public https on port 443 or 8443; private and internal addresses are refused.

fields.label: Topic
fields.help: Letters, digits, - and _ only. Topics on ntfy.sh are public to anyone who knows the name, so pick a hard-to-guess one or use an access token.

fields.label: Access token
fields.help: Optional. For protected topics: sent as a Bearer token.

fields.label: Priority
fields.help: Automatic: urgent for KEV or critical findings, low for resolved ones and recoveries.

types.label: Webhook
types.description: HTTPS POST of a JSON payload, signed with HMAC-SHA256.

fields.label: URL
fields.help: Public https endpoint (port 443 or 8443). Private and internal addresses are refused.

fields.label: Signing secret
fields.help: Generated for you and shown once. Verify the X-Upkeep-Signature header with it (docs/WEBHOOKS.md).
